successCriteria.description: The IApiClient interface exposes five write methods — createLeave(input: CreateLeaveRequestInput), submitLeave(id), approveLeave(id), rejectLeave(id), cancelLeave(id) — each returning Promise<LeaveRequestView>.

ApiClient implements all five methods by delegating to the existing private request<T>() with authenticated: true, so each attaches the bearer token from ITokenStorage and clears it on a 401 response.
createLeave serializes the input as a JSON body (JSON.stringify) and the four action methods send no body, matching the backend contract.

A non-2xx response from any of the five methods is mapped to an ApiError carrying the backend's `error` message and `code` (e.g. an insufficient-balance rejection surfaces the API's own message verbatim).

CreateLeaveRequestInput is added to web/src/shared/types/index.ts with leaveTypeCode: LeaveTypeCode and startDate/endDate as ISO 8601 strings (never Date), reusing the existing LeaveTypeCode enum and adding/renaming no other type.

Vitest coverage asserts each method issues the correct method/path/body (POST /leaves with the JSON body for create; POST /leaves/:id/submit|approve|reject|cancel with no body), attaches the bearer token, and maps a non-2xx body to ApiError.

constraints: All five methods must use the existing private request<T>() pattern (authenticated: true) — no new fetch/error-handling path may be introduced; bearer-token attachment, 401 token clear, and ApiError mapping via toApiError are reused unchanged.
Dates cross the wire as ISO 8601 strings only; CreateLeaveRequestInput.startDate/endDate are strings, never Date objects.
The four action methods (submit/approve/reject/cancel) take no body, matching the backend contract.
Only the CreateLeaveRequestInput DTO is added to shared-types; the existing LeaveTypeCode enum is reused and no other type is added or renamed.
Web tests use Vitest (the existing web test runner), not Jest.
outOfScope: No backend changes — the five endpoints already exist; this phase only extends the web transport layer.
No domain service, page, or composition-root changes — ILeaveService extension, RequestLeavePage, LeaveDetailPage, and route wiring belong to later phases.
No client-side validation or action-matrix logic (getAvailableLeaveActions / validateLeaveRequestInput) — those are Phase 2.
No change to LeaveRequestView's existing date typing (currently Date) — only the new CreateLeaveRequestInput DTO uses ISO strings.

ambiguities.description: LeaveRequestView currently types startDate/endDate as Date, while the new CreateLeaveRequestInput uses ISO strings. The phase only adds the DTO and does not change LeaveRequestView; the response type's Date fields remain as-is this phase.
options: Leave LeaveRequestView dates as Date (out of scope this phase)
Also convert LeaveRequestView dates to ISO strings

entityInvariants.invariant: A wire DTO owned by shared-types whose startDate/endDate are ISO 8601 strings (never Date objects) and whose leaveTypeCode is a member of the existing LeaveTypeCode enum; it is the only new type introduced this phase.

The transport interface gains exactly five write operations (createLeave, submitLeave, approveLeave, rejectLeave, cancelLeave), each returning Promise<LeaveRequestView>; the existing read/login operations are unchanged.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Reuse the existing private request<T>() method and its toApiError mapping exactly as implemented — the five new methods must not introduce a divergent fetch/error path.
Reuse the existing ApiError type (status, code, message) as the sole error type thrown by the new methods.
Reuse the existing ITokenStorage contract (getToken/clear) for bearer-token attachment and 401 clearing — no new token handling.
Reuse the existing LeaveTypeCode enum and LeaveRequestView type; add only CreateLeaveRequestInput with ISO-string dates.
Match the existing test style (vitest, vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch'), jsonResponse helper, sessionStorage.clear in afterEach) when adding coverage.

integrationPoints.why: The five write methods are the web transport for these already-served endpoints; the action endpoints take no body.
The sole error type the new methods surface to callers.
Supplies the bearer token and is cleared on 401 for the authenticated write calls.
